data.title: Portugal XI vs Norway – Predicted lineup and team news - Yahoo Sports
data.content: # Portugal XI vs Norway – Predicted lineup and team news. **On Sunday,** **Portugal** **and** **Norway** **face off in their second UEFA Nations League group-stage meeting at Oslo's Ullevaal Stadion.**. Portugal come into this fixture with a winning start to their Nations League campaign but show uneven form overall. ## Portugal team news. Left-back Nuno Mendes is dealing with late muscle fatigue picked up in the Wales win, but medical staff expect him to be available for selection. He is likely to be supported on the flanks by João Félix, who keeps his place after scoring the decisive goal in the 1-0 victory over Wales. ## Portugal predicted lineup. ## When will the match kick off? The match will kick off at 7:45pm BST on Sunday, 27th September. In the United Kingdom, the Norway vs Portugal UEFA Nations League group match will be streamed live online via Amazon Prime Video.

data.title: England batter Jos Buttler ruled out of Pakistan white-ball tour after injury in second ODI against Sri Lanka - Sky Spor
data.content: # England batter Jos Buttler ruled out of Pakistan white-ball tour after injury in second ODI against Sri Lanka. Jos Buttler will miss England's white-ball tour of Pakistan after suffering an injury against Sri Lanka in the second ODI at Headingley; Tom Banton opened the batting in the third ODI on Sunday, making 126 off 105 balls in his absence; Jordan Cox expected to keep wicket. Jos Buttler was forced to retire after a hamstring injury during England's second ODI against Sri Lanka. England will begin the next phase of their preparations for the 50-over World Cup without Jos Buttler after the former captain was ruled out of their upcoming white-ball tour of Pakistan. He sat out Sunday's series decider at the Kia Oval, which England won comfortably by 223 runs, and has now been ruled out of next month's 50-over tri-series. Highlights of England against Sri Lanka in their third ODI at The Oval.

data.title: England vs Sri Lanka: Jos Buttler's bravery in vain as tourists fight back to level series - BBC
data.content: # Buttler injury halts England as Sri Lanka level series. **Jos Buttler's bravery came in vain as Sri Lanka fought back to beat England in the second one-day international at Headingley and set up a series decider at The Oval.**. England were left needing 19 from the last with Buttler on strike but, barely able to hobble a single, he holed out at deep mid-wicket. England finished on 306-9 as Sri Lanka won by 16 runs. Buttler had earlier shown flashes of his vintage best in hitting Sri Lanka's spinners for five sixes, putting England on course after collapse of 3-14 spoiled an opening stand of 143 between Tom Banton and Ben Duckett. Sri Lanka were fortunate for the way he was abruptly halted but deserve credit for the way their seamers used reverse swing afterwards to deny England's lower order. This has been a difficult tour for Sri Lanka, who were outclassed in the 3-0 T20 series defeat and well beaten by 89 runs in the first ODI at Chester-le-Street.
